name: Barntrup (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Barntrup (a half star and a half rose in red on yellow and white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 27 January 1971 the city of Barntrup was granted the right to bear arms, a flag and a banner.

features.role: Barntrup arms — half star and half rose
